thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for tenant 'endeavor' — sudden 429 surge in private dedicated pool ded-pool-east-2. Metrics window: 11:04-11:09 UTC.

aria (oncall): seeing ~8% of requests returning 429s, started ~11:03. customer traffic is spiky right now. paging sam.

sam (sre): on it. do we know if this is quota enforcement or pool saturation?

leo (infra): initial signal looks like per-tenant rate limiter hitting soft cap, plus queue length on the pool's ingress. GPU utilization is fine (60%), but token throughput is peaky.

hana (support): Endeavor is reporting failed inference calls in prod. Their engineers say behavior started after a batch job at 10:59. They are asking for temporary relief — high business impact.

aria (oncall): moving to incident channel. tagging @mira for contract override / emergency lift approval if needed.

mira (acct): I can approve an emergency contract lift under the enterprise playbook if SRE recommends. need estimate of duration and token delta.

sam (sre): mitigation plan proposal: 1) divert Endeavor traffic from ded-pool-east-2 to spare dedicated pool ded-pool-east-3 (compatible model variants). 2) temporarily raise tenant soft-limit to 2x for 30 minutes. 3) enable prefix KV cache for repeated prefixes from the batch job. 4) monitor.

leo (infra): diversion path ready. two caveats: 1) ded-pool-east-3 has ongoing canary; we can isolate traffic via tenant routing policy. 2) model quantization variant m-gpt-2q is compatible fallback.

sam (sre): request ETA on routing change?

leo (infra): can push routing rule in ~90s. command: 
```
rbw route apply --tenant endeavor --from ded-pool-east-2 --to ded-pool-east-3 --mode spillover --reason "emergency 429 mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: routing rule apply queued. PR #8243 created for audit.

ops-bot: audit log: route-change initiated by leo at 11:07:12 UTC.

aria (oncall): mira, if we do the diversion + soft-limit bump, what's the billing/contract implication?

mira (acct): short answer: we can authorize a 30-minute emergency burst up to +150% of committed tokens under emergency clause, billing will record as overage. I'll notify finance and mark the ticket. Please include expected token delta.

sam (sre): estimating additional tokens: current 5m window saw +120k token delta vs baseline. With 2x soft-limit for 30m we may add ~400k tokens.

mira (acct): approved for 30 minutes and up to +500k tokens. filing approval: APPROVED-2468202468.

leo (infra): applying soft-limit bump now. command: 
```
adminctl tenant-rate set --tenant endeavor --soft 2.0 --duration 1800
```

ops-bot: tenant-rate change committed (actor=leo, tenant=endeavor, soft=2.0, ttl=1800s).

sam (sre): traffic diverted, ded-pool-east-3 accepting connections. early signs: 429 rate dropped to ~1.1% within 45s. p50 latency stabilized.

hana (support): Endeavor confirms calls recovering. They asked whether we can keep logging verbose for 15m to capture root cause traces.

sam (sre): enabling request-level debug sampling for tenant = endeavor for 15m. will redact PII.

ops-bot: debug sampling enabled (tenant=endeavor, duration=900s, rate=1%).

aria (oncall): quick check — any risk to the canary on ded-pool-east-3?

leo (infra): canary instance is isolated; diversion uses separate worker set. risk low.

sam (sre): continuing monitoring. setting incident severity to SEV2 due to partial customer impact. paging on-call followups: @aria after stabilization please coordinate RCA loop with customer.

deploy-bot: alert: automated rollback of experimental kernels in ded-pool-east-2 completed at 11:12:34 UTC (related to earlier canary). Might correlate with token pattern.

sam (sre): note — batch job that hana mentioned seems to be a high-fanout request pattern hitting the tenant's prefix cache cold. enabling prefix KV cache should help persistent calls. will toggle now.

leo (infra): prefix cache enabled for tenant. config: 
```
cachectl set-prefix --tenant endeavor --max-size 200MB --eviction lru
```

ops-bot: prefix cache change logged.

aria (oncall): timeline so far: 11:03 spike -> 11:07 route diversion & soft-limit bump -> 11:08 429s down to ~1% -> 11:10 prefix cache on -> 11:15 stabilization.

hana (support): Endeavor wants a short summary they can share with internal stakeholders. I'll draft while you stabilize.

sam (sre): post-incident next steps: 1) full logs export for 11:00-11:20 (sam). 2) run traffic replay against staging to reproduce and tune rate-limit (leo). 3) propose permanent routing for heavy batch windows or advise scheduling. (mira to coordinate contract if they want sustained higher commit).

mira (acct): will propose a temporary capacity increase/premium burst package. will follow up within 24h.

aria (oncall): OK — lowering pager. keep thread for RCA. please add any findings.

ops-bot: incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. incident closed as active outage resolved at 11:16 UTC; will remain in monitoring mode until 12:00 UTC.

sam (sre): capturing quick logs snippet for RCA: 
```
11:03:02 tenant=endeavor reqs=2200/s 429=7.9% queue=312
11:06:30 tenant=endeavor reqs=1800/s 429=1.0% queue=28
11:11:10 tenant=endeavor reqs=1600/s 429=0.3% queue=10
```

aria (oncall): thanks team. action items captured. mira please create bill/contract follow-up. leo/sam — include mitigation runbook steps so we can automate spillover for similar patterns. hana — send customer summary + support ticket link.

mira (acct): Acked. APPROVAL NOTE: emergency lift authorized under APPROVED-2468202468.

hana (support): Draft to customer sent. customer replied: "Thanks — we'll gate the batch job and may ask for sustained burst next week; will coordinate with mira." :thumbsup:

sam (sre): I'll produce an RCA doc and include timeline + config diffs. tagging this as incident-2468202468 for tracking.

aria (oncall): incident handoff complete. leaving notes and setting follow-ups. thanks all.
